fig01: Fig. 1. End-to-end source-space EEG graph-learning pipeline. Resting-state eyes-closed EEG (OpenNeuro ds004504; 19 electrodes; 36 AD, 29 HC) is segmented at provider boundary events, resampled to 250 Hz and average-referenced; five minutes per participant are cut into 10 s windows with a 1 s step (mode B; mode A uses the first 10 accepted windows). Sources are reconstructed with LCMV or depth-weighted wMNE into 68 Desikan-Killiany ROI signals and aggregated to coarser atlases (r18, lobes12). Per window and band, PLV (or |ciPLV|), PSD and differential entropy define weighted band graphs on which a graph network is trained for 60 epochs; window probabilities are averaged per participant and evaluated by five-fold participant-grouped cross-validation on the 52 development participants.
fig02: Fig. 2. Architecture of the primary model (exp8a_xu_dual_gcn_surface, variant plv__psd). For each of five bands, a band-specific graph convolution propagates [log PSD, relative PSD] node features over the window's own PLV graph (layer 1, 2 -> 32), then over a fixed 12 x 12 cortical-surface-contiguity matrix (layer 2, 32 -> 2). Band outputs (5 x 12 x 2 = 120) are flattened, passed through dropout (0.3) and two fully connected layers (32, 32) to one logit. N(A) = D^(-1/2)(A + I)D^(-1/2). The anatomical matrix is an atlas-derived neighbourhood prior, not structural (white-matter) connectivity. 5,771 trainable parameters.
fig03: Fig. 3. Atlas resolution under a 19-electrode montage. (a-c) Region centroids (fsaverage white surface, axial projection) of dk68, r18 and lobes12, coloured by lobe; lines in (c) are the 22 surface-contiguity edges of the anatomical layer. (d-f) Exact-BEM resolution analysis for LCMV and wMNE: median cross-talk (rule <= 0.60), own-region dominance (rule >= 0.80) and participation ratio; the leadfield has numerical rank 18 and entropy-effective rank 12.8. Only lobes12 meets both criteria for both inverses (r18 misses dominance for LCMV, 0.778). dk34_gyral is analysed only (not classified). (g, h) Participant-level development-CV AUC and balanced accuracy of the same matched models (Exp4 band-mean GCN, Exp5 separate-encoder multiband GCN; LCMV and wMNE; PLV; mode B; dense graph; n = 52) on dk68, lobes12 and r18; no difference is statistically supported, and lobes12 was recorded as the analysis atlas.
fig04: Fig. 4. Performance of the GNN families and of single frequency bands. (a) Participant-level development-CV ROC-AUC (n = 52) of every configuration in Exp2-Exp8a, window mode B; dots are configurations, bars are medians. The spread reflects differences between configurations and is not a confidence interval. (b) Exp3 single-band GCN (lobes12, dense): observed AUC for each band, inverse solution and connectivity measure. No band difference was tested with correction.
fig05: Fig. 5. Participant-level out-of-fold ROC curves and confusion matrices (threshold 0.5) for the primary model (Exp8a, LCMV, PLV + PSD, lobes12), the Exp5 separate-encoder multiband GCN on r18 and the Exp4 band-mean GCN reference on lobes12 (all LCMV, mode B, dense; one score per participant, n = 52: 29 AD, 23 HC). AUC 0.858 (DeLong 95% CI 0.749-0.966), 0.859 (0.743-0.975) and 0.844 (0.725-0.963). Paired DeLong tests recomputed from the saved predictions (uncorrected, descriptive) show no difference (primary vs Exp5 r18: dAUC -0.001, p = 0.96; primary vs Exp4: +0.013, p = 0.63). Development cross-validation, not independent test performance; the model was emphasised retrospectively.
fig06: Fig. 6. Ablations and robustness. (a) Exp8a: AUC of the full model (PLV, PSD + DE + strength) minus each ablation or alternative, per inverse; bars are paired participant-bootstrap 95% intervals (uncorrected); Holm-adjusted p-values are those saved for the comparison family. No ablation is supported. (b) Matched pairs differing in one factor (GNN configurations only): PLV vs |ciPLV| (n = 46), LCMV vs wMNE (n = 116), window mode B vs A (n = 116); each dot is one pair, bars are medians, the pink dot is the single pair supported after Holm correction (Exp7, LCMV, |ciPLV| mean fusion; mode B > A).
figS_selection: Fig. S1. Selection optimism. For each candidate set, the observed best AUC (n = 52), the mean bootstrap out-of-bag winner AUC, observed minus the bootstrap optimism, and the 95th percentile of the best-of-m AUC under permuted labels. Participants were resampled with replacement; the winner was chosen in-bag and scored on out-of-bag participants. This is a within-development estimate, not an independent test.
figS_holdout: Fig. S2. Descriptive holdout of the single selected model (wMNE, Exp8a plv__psd_de_strength__abl_anatomical_both, lobes12, dense): 13 participants (7 AD, 6 HC), fitted once on the 52 development participants. The holdout had been inspected in earlier work and is not an untouched test; it is not the LCMV plv__psd primary model.
figS_graph: Fig. S3. Graph construction on lobes12 (mode B, n = 52): participant-level AUC of eleven constructions for the Exp4 band-mean GCN and the Exp5 separate-encoder GCN. The pre-specified rule kept the dense graph; the feature-similarity graph is reported only.
figS_exp6: Fig. S4. Exp6 feature, fusion and band ablations (mode B): participant-level AUC with DeLong 95% intervals (n = 52).
figS_bands: Fig. S5. Exp3 single-band GCN, balanced accuracy at threshold 0.5 (lobes12, dense, mode B).
